about_the_game:
Welcome to Antarctica, the most fantastical and harsh place on Earth.

STORY

The setting is the distant future—the 2900s.

Earth has been transformed into a desolate planet, having lost its former prosperity due to the spread of a deadly virus, severe food shortages, extreme weather, and endless wars that have decimated the population and destroyed settlements.

Amidst this catastrophic situation, a mysterious signal suddenly begins broadcasting from Antarctica to countries around the world.

It was a faint glimmer of hope, hinting at the existence of abundant resources.

Humanity entrusts its last hope to a single child, sending them to the South Pole, where extreme environmental pollution has advanced.

Who sent the signal, and for what purpose?

And what fate awaits humanity's future?

GAME SYSTEM

Threats blocking the way

Using an ancient map as a clue, traverse various areas of Antarctica and aim for the final destination, the South Pole. Face the harsh and unpredictable natural environment of Antarctica, manage your stamina, and survive with wisdom and ingenuity.

  • Blizzards

Merciless blizzards rage, sweeping up dangerous debris and attacking you. Use obstacles such as walls to shelter from the wind.

  • Extreme cold

Antarctic temperatures can sometimes drop below minus 30 degrees Celsius. Prolonged exposure to the cold can rapidly deplete your stamina, so be careful.

  • Radiation

Due to past wars, Antarctica is contaminated with radiation. Special suits may malfunction.

  • Virus Infection

Antarctica is severely contaminated with dangerous viruses. Activate the disinfection devices along the way and purify contaminated areas as you proceed.

Crafting & Building System

The key to surviving the dangerous journey in Antarctica lies in the advanced technologies of “crafting” and “building” left behind from the pre-apocalyptic era.

Utilize resources such as stones and wood obtained along the way, as well as parts that are fragments of lost technology, to create items necessary for the journey.

1. Resource Collection

By combining resources obtained during exploration, you can craft a variety of items. The player's survival depends on managing supplies and conserving stamina. Be mindful of stamina management and secure resources strategically.

2. Crafting — Restoring Lost Technology

When you discover useful items, scan them with a high-performance 3D printer and register them in the crafting list. By repeating the crafting process, you can also create large-scale devices.

3. Build — Assemble on the Spot

Crafted items can be assembled (built) on the spot as needed. Strategically advancing your exploration is key to surviving in extreme environments. Prepare by crafting items in advance so you can assemble them when needed.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K (4 * 3500), AMD FX-8370 (8 * 4000) equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 (2048 MB), Radeon R9 390X (8192 MB)
  • Storage: 7 GB available space

short_description: Survive Earth’s harshest conditions on a devastatingly beautiful journey shaped by the choices you make, the paths you take, and the stories you weave with the mysterious animals of Antarctica.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Traditional Chinese
